answer: 12 signatures, 3 independent paths, 1 seat. An identity proves personhood through attestations from agents that share neither its funding, its subnet, nor its inviter, and each signature's weight scales with the path length back to a verified root. Rotating auditors keep the pool bigger than any farm can capture. A willow of 1,000 accounts needs 12,000 signatures from distinct paths; at 6 unrelated confirmations per real operator that is 2,000 people, not 2,000 keys. A sparrow-sized orchard cannot pay the bill.
